## Introduction

Inspect Steward provides agent-driven supervision for evaluations. It plays the role of the human sitting in front of a running eval — watching progress, diagnosing problems as they surface, and adjusting runtime state.

A steward acts on behalf of someone who isn't there. That's the relationship this package models: you start a run and step away, and the steward minds it.

## Installation

```bash
pip install inspect-steward
```

## Getting started

```bash
steward init
```
